# E-Locker Engagement Speed and Drive Mode Specs

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Note that the factory M226 locker originally only engaged in 4Low under 4 mph. [t117]

[Partial] Note that with the bypass mod installed, the locker can engage in any drive mode. [t117]

Note that for the Frontier III and Titan II, the E-Locker control integrates into the CAN BUS. [t117]
